name: init_mcb_bounds
desc: Reads the memory block size from its MCB and calculates segment boundaries
details: Accesses the DOS Memory Control Block (MCB) located one paragraph before the segment stored at cs:[0x8E]. It extracts the block size in paragraphs from offset 0x03 of the MCB, saves it into cs:[0x90], and calculates the upper segment limit (base + size + 1) which is saved into cs:[0x0A9].

instrs.comment: Get base segment and step back one paragraph to the MCB
Read block size (in paragraphs) from MCB offset 3
Save block size, then calculate and store boundary segment (base + size + 1)
